title: Stop waiting for the map. God is only giving you the compass. 🧭🔥
paragraphs: Stop waiting for the map. God is only giving you the compass. 🧭🔥

The reason you feel stuck is that you’re waiting for the resources before you take the risk. That’s not faith; that’s calculation. The Red Sea didn’t part until their feet touched the water. The manna didn’t fall until they were in the wilderness.
If He said "Move," your obedience is the trigger for His provision. The path doesn't appear until you start walking.
Be a Gospel Warrior. Take the step.
📖 Verse of the Day: "By faith Abraham, when called to go to a place he would later receive as his inheritance, obeyed and went, even though he did not know where he was going." - Hebrews 11:8 (NIV)
👇 Are you waiting on God, or is God waiting on your first step? Drop a "🔥" if you're ready to move.
